title: The Fulfillment of Isaiah's Prophecy about Unbelief
description: Despite the many signs Jesus performed, the people did not believe in him. John explains this as a fulfillment of Isaiah's prophecy that God has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts. Yet many did believe, even among the rulers, but they would not confess it openly for fear of being expelled from the synagogue, because they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
